### [App SDK](https://docs.attio.com/sdk/)

Develop Typescript React applications that run natively on Attio’s platform.

### REST API

Develop apps that read and write information to and from workspaces.

## Start building.

Create custom apps, automations, and integrations on top of Attio.

01

### Create your appCreate your app

Head over to our [developer console](https://build.attio.com/) and sign in with your Attio account. Create your app and give it a unique name.

02

### DevelopDevelop

Use React, TypeScript, and our [App SDK](https://docs.attio.com/sdk/) to build your app that runs natively inside of Attio.

03

### Manage authenticationManage authentication

Connect to your service by configuring OAuth or access tokens.

04

### Configure your listingConfigure your listing

Give your app a logo, a description, and screenshots, to show users what it does.

05

### PublishPublish

Submit your app for review via the developer console, and share it with your users.

[Learn more on docs.attio.com](https://docs.attio.com/sdk/)

## Explore existing apps.

See what other developers have built in Attio.

Visit the App Store to explore the apps and integrations that extend Attio’s functionality.

[Discover apps](https://attio.com/apps)

The app partner program is open to all developers, although we’re especially interested in working with teams who have mutual customers with Attio and are looking to build an integration between our products.

###

We don’t offer native monetization as part of the App Store, but you are free to charge users of your app how you see fit.
